tweets.text: In the Name of God, the Beneficent, the Merciful

The child‑killing US and Zionist demons martyred the young students of the Shajarah Tayyibah [Blessed Tree] School. But the Iranian nation will plant seedlings of hope throughout the land, so that each one, God willing, will bear abundant fruit in the years to come.
One such commendable action is for people in all cities and villages to plant fruit trees starting from Nature Day and continuing until the end of spring.
At a time when the US-Zionist enemy has even attacked the natural environment and ecological spaces of our beloved homeland, any efforts aimed at development are necessary acts.

The heroic nation of Iran has intertwined this Nowruz with an epic spirit and a deep sense of honor. After commemorating the 12th of Farvardin, which is the National Islamic Republic Day, they now prepare to welcome Nature Day.

In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

“It is He who brought you into being from the earth and made you its inhabitants” (Quran 11:61).

The US President has said that for 47 years, the US hasn't been able to eliminate the Islamic Republic. That confession is true. I say, "You, too, won’t be able to do such a thing."
Feb. 17, 2026
#Islamic_Republic_of_Iran

I offer my congratulations and condolences on the martyrdom of the courageous commander Tangsiri to his esteemed family and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. I pray Almighty God will raise this martyr to the highest ranks [in the Hereafter].
God willing, the martyrdom of Admiral Tangsiri will enable the country to continue along the path of Iran’s maritime authority and resistance with even greater strength and firmness than before.

The martyrdom of this Iranian soldier and a guardian of Islam in the course of the epic Third Imposed War is a great source of pride for the Iranian nation who have always been protectors of Iran’s independence and its maritime borders, particularly the Persian Gulf.
